children: may retest support at $3,971 per ounce, a break below which could open the way toward $3,945-$3,957 range.
A double-top has been confirmed, suggesting a target around $3,895. A series of projection levels based on the uptrend from $3,895 still work well as supports and resistances.

Immediate resistance is at $3,995, a break above which may lead to a gain into $4,009-$4,018 range. On the daily chart, wave pattern indicates the completion of a wave (4) and a progress of a wave (5).
The latter is capable of travelling below $3,870, the bottom of the wave (3).
